why: Merck's 2 March 2020 release (Business Wire dated 20200302) reports that KEYNOTE-204 met its PFS primary endpoint at a pre-specified interim analysis versus brentuximab vedotin in R/R cHL, with the OS co-primary still to be assessed.

Gilead's 2 Nov 2022 FDA-approval release (listed in the drugs.com Vemlidy history) reports Trial 1092's week-24 primary endpoint for the adolescent cohort: HBV DNA <20 IU/mL in 21% on TAF vs 0% on placebo; the younger Cohort 2 reported later (FDA label expansion to age 6+ on 28 Mar 2024) and its youngest groups set the 2026 completion date; no earlier conference readout was found.

The 10 Dec 2025 Pharmaceutical Technology piece reports this placebo-controlled R/R FLT3 AML phase 3 met its EFS primary endpoint (HR 0.64, p=0.013), but an ASH 2025 interview published 8 Dec 2025 already reported significant EFS improvement (the ASH abstract may have been public earlier, which I could not verify).

The NEJM paper reports POLARIX's investigator-assessed PFS primary endpoint (met), but Roche/Genentech had already announced that POLARIX met its primary endpoint in a release dated 8 Aug 2021 (Roche 9 Aug 2021).

The JCO paper reports CANOVA's PFS primary endpoint, but AbbVie had already reported at IMS on 29 Sep 2023 that VenDex vs PomDex did not significantly improve PFS (9.9 vs 5.8 months, HR 0.823, p=0.237).

The NEJM paper reports KarMMa-3's PFS primary result from the interim analysis, but BMS and 2seventy bio had already announced topline results on 10 Aug 2022: PFS was significantly improved at the pre-specified interim analysis.

The Nature Medicine paper reports the 1801 Part 3B randomized result (elraglusib+GnP vs GnP in 1L mPDAC; OS met), but Actuate had already announced on 17 Dec 2024 that a pre-specified interim analysis met the Part 3B primary endpoint (mOS 9.3 vs 7.2 months, HR 0.63, p=0.016).

AstraZeneca's release, published 18 June 2024, states that CAPItello-290 did not meet its dual OS primary endpoints (overall and PIK3CA/AKT1/PTEN-altered populations), which ended the trial's primary analysis early.

The JCO paper reports EXCLAIM-2's IRC-assessed PFS primary endpoint (not met), but Takeda had already announced on 2 Oct 2023 that EXCLAIM-2 missed its primary endpoint and that it would withdraw mobocertinib.

The 2 Jul 2024 Cartesian release reports the randomized placebo-controlled Phase 2b part, which the AAN 2025 abstract identifies as NCT04146051, meeting its primary endpoint (MGC >=5-point improvement at Month 3: 71% vs 25%, p=0.018).

Kamada's 8 Dec 2025 release says a prespecified interim futility analysis of InnovAATe found the trial unlikely to show a significant benefit on its FEV1 primary endpoint, so it was discontinued (early stop for futility).

The recorded eJHaem DOI could not be opened (publisher refused) and searches did not identify the article; the only public data found for XPORT-MF-035 (EHA 2025, 14 May 2025 release: 12 vs 12 randomized) gave SVR35 at any time (33% vs 13%), not the primary week-24 SVR35, so neither the source nor the met status could be verified.
Merck/Eisai announced on 28 Oct 2025 that LITESPARK-011 met its PFS primary endpoint at a prespecified interim analysis (OS, the other primary endpoint, not yet significant).
The NEJM paper reports DESTINY-Gastric04's primary OS result, but Daiichi Sankyo/AstraZeneca first announced on 3 Mar 2025 that the trial met its OS primary endpoint at a planned interim analysis.

The 5 Nov 2024 Arcus release reports ARC-10's primary endpoint (PFS) for the randomized Part 1 (dom+zim vs zim HR 0.69, 95% CI 0.40-1.18, no significant benefit; later published in Lung Cancer 2026); no separate result for the amended Part 2 vs pembrolizumab was found.

CNS Pharmaceuticals' 25 Mar 2025 release gives the primary analysis of this trial (NCT04762069, 252 patients, berubicin vs lomustine 2:1) and says it did not show statistically significant superiority in OS, the primary endpoint.

The VJOncology ASCO 2026 interview (30 May 2026) covers the IMbrave251 (NCT04770896) final analysis and says the OS primary endpoint was not met; no earlier announcement was found, though the ASCO abstract may have been posted a few days earlier.

The NEJM Evidence paper/AHA 2025 presentation (10 Nov 2025) reports CELEBRATE's primary results, but CeleCor's topline announcement on 23 Sep 2025 already said the trial met its primary efficacy and safety endpoints.

The 23 Apr 2025 FDA approval of penpulimab plus chemotherapy for first-line R/M NPC rests on AK105-304 (this trial), whose BICR-PFS primary endpoint was met (9.6 vs 7.0 mo, HR 0.45); no earlier topline statement was found (AACR 2025 presentation came days later), so moderate confidence.
AVEO's 18 Jul 2024 release on TiNivo-2 (cites NCT04987203) states that adding nivolumab to tivozanib did not meet the PFS primary endpoint versus tivozanib monotherapy.
Ipsen's 19 Dec 2025 announcement (carried by IFOPA) says FALKON did not meet its primary endpoint of reducing new heterotopic ossification versus placebo and the study is being closed.

The NEJM paper (10.1056/NEJMoa2517729, announced 27 May 2026) reports HERIZON-GEA-01's primary results, but the first public statement was the 17 Nov 2025 topline release reporting statistically significant PFS for both zanidatamab arms and significant OS for the zanidatamab+tislelizumab arm.

The NEJM paper reports VISIONARY's uPCR primary result, but Otsuka first announced on 22 Oct 2024 that the prespecified interim analysis (NCT05248646, 400 mg vs placebo) met the 9-month uPCR primary endpoint.

Hengrui's 29 Jan 2026 NMPA-filing notice describes this 423-patient phase 3 (SHR-1210-III-336/CARES-336) of TACE+camrelizumab+apatinib vs TACE, whose interim analysis showed significant BIRC-PFS improvement, later presented at ASCO 2026 (HR 0.73); no earlier statement found.

AstraZeneca's 29 Apr 2025 update says CAPItello-280 was discontinued after the IDMC concluded at a prespecified interim analysis that it was unlikely to meet its dual rPFS and OS primary endpoints (futility stop).

Corcept's 11 Dec 2024 release reports that the DAZALS phase 2 (dazucorilant 150/300 mg vs placebo, 24 weeks) did not meet its ALSFRS-R primary endpoint; the later registered completion reflects the open-label extension.

The JCO paper reports VIKTORIA-1 PFS results, but Celcuity first announced on 28 Jul 2025 that the PIK3CA wild-type cohort met its PFS primary endpoint (triplet HR 0.24, doublet HR 0.33); the PIK3CA-mutant cohort also met its primary endpoint on 1 May 2026.

The source reports the 18 Mar 2025 HUTCHMED/Innovent announcement that FRUSICA-2 (NCT05522231; sintilimab+fruquintinib vs axitinib or everolimus, second-line advanced RCC in China) met its BICR-assessed PFS primary endpoint, i.e. an early readout of the Part I randomized primary.

On 12 Dec 2025 Arcus/Gilead announced STAR-221 was discontinued after the IDMC's pre-specified interim OS analysis showed dom+zim+chemo did not improve OS vs nivolumab+chemo, an early stop on this trial's primary endpoint.

The 14 Nov 2025 BMS release states Librexia ACS was stopped after a preplanned IDMC interim analysis found it unlikely to meet its primary MACE endpoint (milvexian vs placebo after ACS), an early futility stop of this trial.

The NEJM paper (announced 14 May 2026) reports TELIGAN's prespecified interim analysis of the week-39 UPCR primary endpoint, but RemeGen/Vor Bio had already announced on 27 Aug 2025 that the 318-patient China phase 3 met this endpoint (55% UPCR reduction vs placebo, p<0.0001), so the date is corrected.

The recorded ARD paper (16 Apr 2026) is the SELECT-SWITCH 12-week primary results report, but AbbVie first announced on 20 Oct 2025 that the study met its week-12 DAS28-CRP<=3.2 primary endpoint (43.3% upadacitinib vs 22.4% adalimumab, p<0.001), so the date is corrected.

The 15 Dec 2025 Aviceda release reports the 12-month analysis of the SIGLEC Part 2 primary endpoint (GA lesion growth slope, AVD-104 vs avacincaptad pegol, n=300), with no statistical difference between arms, so the efficacy primary was not met.

MacroGenics' 12 Nov 2025 Q3 8-K states that interim LORIKEET data (17 Oct 2025 cutoff) from this ~150-patient randomized phase 2 show lorigerlimab+docetaxel will not reach the rPFS primary goal vs docetaxel, an interim readout of this trial's primary.

The source covers ST Pharm's IDWeek 2025 (19-22 Oct) oral presentation of interim phase 2a data for cohorts 1-2 (200/400 mg pirmitegravir vs placebo, 10 days) showing significant Day-11 HIV-1 RNA declines (about -1.2 to -1.55 log10, p<0.0001), an interim of this trial's primary; the exact session day was not confirmed (earliest press coverage 21 Oct KST), so the conference start date is kept.
The 18 Feb 2026 Novartis release reports positive topline results of RemIND (NCT05976243), with the week-12 complete-response primary endpoint met vs placebo in all three CIndU subtypes.

Rhythm's 9 Jul 2025 release reports topline 14-week BMI change from this 28-patient randomized placebo-controlled Phase 2 of bivamelagon (LB54640, 200/400/600 mg) in acquired hypothalamic obesity, with statistically significant BMI reductions vs placebo (the later registered completion reflects the open-label extension).

Merck's 22 Jun 2026 release names NCT06052059 (ATLAS-UC) and reports that Study 2 (induction-only) met its registered primary endpoint of clinical remission per MMS at Week 12; Study 1 (induction plus maintenance) was still ongoing.

The 13 May 2025 report states an interim analysis of GALAXIES H&N-202 showed the belrestotug combination cohorts' ORR trended below the meaningful threshold vs dostarlimab monotherapy (the registered primary comparison), so those cohorts were stopped; other platform substudies (nelistotug, remzistotug) have no public primary result found.

Anaptys's 10 Nov 2025 release reports the global Phase 2 rosnilimab trial in moderate-to-severe UC (136 enrolled) did not meet its primary endpoint of mean change in modified Mayo Score at Week 12, matching ROSETTA.

Tanabe's parent company announced on 15 Jan 2026 (US release 20 Jan) that the Phase 3 INSPIRE study (NCT06144840, 165 patients) of dersimelagon in EPP/XLP met its primary endpoint on time to first prodromal symptoms with sunlight exposure.

Ocular Therapeutix's 17 Feb 2026 release names NCT06223958 (SOL-1, 344 patients, AXPAXLI vs aflibercept) and reports the Week 36 primary endpoint of maintaining vision (<15-letter BCVA loss) was met (74.1% vs 55.8%, p=0.0006).

BioNTech's 5 Sep 2025 release names NCT06265428 (China Phase 3, 228 patients, DB-1303/BNT323 vs T-DM1 in previously treated HER2-positive breast cancer) and reports it met its BICR-assessed PFS primary endpoint at a pre-specified interim analysis.

The 28 Jan 2026 announcement is a discontinuation after the IDMC flagged a mortality-imbalance safety concern at an interim review, with no efficacy result on the primary endpoint (days alive, ventilator-free and KRT-free through Day 30), and later company releases and filings through May 2026 still report none.
Celldex's 22 Sep 2026 release reports EMBARQ-CSU1 (NCT06445023, 963 patients) met its primary endpoint of mean change in UAS7 at Week 12 for both barzolvolimab doses vs placebo (p<0.00001).
Celldex's 22 Sep 2026 release names EMBARQ-CSU2 as NCT06455202 and reports both barzolvolimab doses beat placebo on the Week 12 UAS7 change (p<0.00001), so this trial's primary endpoint was met.
Hansoh's 10 Jul 2026 announcement says HS-20093 (risvutatug rezetecan) met the overall survival primary endpoint against topotecan in relapsed SCLC at a planned interim analysis of ARTEMIS-008.

The 3 Mar 2026 Kyowa Kirin/Amgen release stopped all rocatinlimab trials over safety (Kaposi's sarcoma cases) and gives no prurigo nodularis efficacy data, and a search found no later public PN primary result.

The 25 Aug 2026 Summit/Akeso release reports that HARMONi-GI1 (OncLive confirms NCT06591520) met its OS primary endpoint for ivonescimab plus chemo over durvalumab plus chemo at a prespecified interim analysis.
The 31 Mar 2026 Gan & Lee release names SUPER-1 as NCT06767735 (insulin-naive T2DM, GZR4 vs glargine U100) and reports the Week 26 HbA1c primary endpoint was met (-1.45% vs -1.22%).
Atea's 28 Jul 2026 release names C-BEYOND as NCT06868264 and reports BEM/RZR was non-inferior to SOF/VEL on HCV RNA <LLOQ at week 24 (93.9% vs 94.8%), so the primary endpoint was met.

J&J's 26 Dec 2025 statement says a planned interim analysis of DUPLEX-AD (NCT06881251) met prespecified early-termination criteria because efficacy fell short, so the trial stopped early for insufficient efficacy.

Immunovant's 23 Sep 2026 topline release on the randomized, placebo-controlled IMVT-1402 CLE proof-of-concept study (57 enrolled) says it did not reach statistical significance on percent change in CLASI-A at Week 12.

BiomX's 8 Dec 2025 release stopped the Phase 2b BX004 trial after a DMC safety review found high adverse-event rates and gives no sputum PsA efficacy data, and a search found no later Phase 2b primary result.
